title: A systematic review of human avoidance learning: Cognition, computation, and methods
title_zh: 人类回避学习的系统综述：认知、计算与方法
abstract: Avoidance behaviour is fundamental for survival but can become maladaptive in clinical conditions. A large body of literature has accumulated on the dynamics of human avoidance learning. However, current theories and overviews do not provide an exhaustive account of this evidence. In this systematic review, we identify N = 116 studies on human avoidance learning. We analyse these studies with the goal of distilling robust empirical phenomena as a basis for theory-building, and examine their diagnostic value in differentiating between competing theories. We find that the evidence is difficult to reconcile with foundational two-factor and classical safety-signal accounts, and most strongly supports expectancy- and inference-based views, in which avoidance responses are selected with respect to represented consequences. At the same time, no current framework provides a complete account of the evidence: several findings point to an additional role for operant valuation, Pavlovian influences, and contextual or latent-state control over the expression of avoidance. Methodologically, we observe that the problem setting in the most common experimental paradigms is radically simpler than real-world avoidance and therefore unlikely to expose the limits of inferential or reflective mechanisms. Consequently, we argue that paradigms with greater computational demands and more realistic action affordances are required to identify the mechanisms underlying avoidance learning. Collectively, these insights provide a foundation for theoretical refinement, computational modelling, and methodological innovation, with implications for advancing interventions targeting maladaptive avoidance.
abstract_zh: 回避行为是生存的基础，但在临床条件下可能变得不适应。大量文献已聚焦人类回避学习的动态。然而，现有理论和综述并未对这些证据作出全面阐述。本系统综述识别了 N = 116 项关于人类回避学习的研究。我们以提炼稳健的经验现象为目标，分析这些研究以构建理论基础，并检视其在区分竞争理论中的诊断价值。结果显示，证据难以与基础的双因素和经典安全信号模型相协调，最强支持基于预期和推理的观点，即回避反应是根据所表征的后果来选择的。同时，现有框架均未能完整解释证据：若干发现提示操作性价值评估、巴甫洛夫影响以及情境或潜在状态对回避表达的额外作用。方法学上，我们观察到最常见实验范式中的问题设置与现实世界的回避截然简单，因而不太可能揭示推理或反思机制的极限。因此，我们认为需要更具计算挑战性且更贴近现实行动的范式，以识别回避学习的底层机制。总体而言，这些见解为理论细化、计算建模和方法创新奠定基础，并对推进针对不适应性回避的干预具有重要意义。
